#### Purpose of this file  

This file has all of the code for the the main analysis to reproduce all figures except Figure S9 in the Schmidt et al. manuscript entitled **"Microhabitats shape diversity-productivity relationships in freshwater bacterial communities"**, published by [FEMS Microbiology Ecology](https://doi.org/10.1093/femsec/fiaa029). 

*Note*: To see how to reproduce figure S9 please see the github for this project and go to [analysis/OTU_Removal_Analysis.html](https://deneflab.github.io/Diversity_Productivity/analysis/OTU_Removal_Analysis.html)  on the github page.

# 1. Prepare Workspace
Load necessary R packages and set default parameters
```{r}

  library(fastmatch)

  library(xlsx)
  library(RColorBrewer)

#--1.2--Set output directories--------

  #--1.2a--Local working directory
    dir_root <- "C:/Users/uax75/OneDrive/Documents/R/BIOcean5D-Coral_Microbiome"
    #  setwd("C:/Users/uax75/OneDrive/Documents/R/BIOcean5D")

  #--1.2b--Prefix to prepend to output files

#--1.3--Define base parameters and custom plotting themes--------
```

# 3. Community Diversity Analysis - Alpha Diversity
*NOTE*: You MUST use the raw (not rarefied!) counts for these estimates to be meaningful
See discussion here: https://github.com/joey711/phyloseq/issues/287 and here: http://joey711.github.io/phyloseq/plot_richness-examples.html

```{r div-alpha}
#--3.1--Calculate richness & alpha diversity indices--------
  # Note that ‘Observed’ is the sample taxonomic richness. 
  # The other three indices combine richness and abundance data for each taxon.

  div_alpha <- estimate_richness(ps_bact,
                                split = TRUE,
                                measures = c("Observed", 
                                             "Shannon", 
                                             "InvSimpson"))

  #--3.1a--Rename 'Observed' to 'Richness'
    names(div_alpha)[names(div_alpha) == 'Observed'] <- 'Richness'

#--3.2--Add other diversity indices not calculated by phyloseq--------

  library(metagMisc)

  species_counts <- phyloseq_ntaxa_by_tax(ps_bact, TaxRank = "Species")
  head(species_counts)

  #--3.2a--Count number of species in each sample
    S <- vegan::specnumber(
      t(as.data.frame(t(ggClusterNet::vegan_otu(ps_bact)))))

  #--3.2b--Calculate diversity indices
    div_alpha$Pielou_evenness <- div_alpha$Shannon/log(S)
    div_alpha$Simpson_evenness <- div_alpha$InvSimpson/S

#--3.3--Add alpha diversity indices to phyloseq object--------

  #--3.3a--merge the two dataframes
    sample_data(ps_bact) <- cbind(sample_data(ps_bact), div_alpha)
    index <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_bact))
    index$SiteSubtypeTransTreat <- paste(index$Site,
                                         index$Subtype,
                                         index$Transplant,
                                         index$Treatment, sep=" ")
                     
#--3.4--Save alpha diversity analysis output(s)--------
  FileName <- paste(dir_output_tab, 
                    "/Table-S1_Alpha-Diversity-Summary_AllIndices.csv",
                    sep = "")
  
  write.csv(index, FileName, sep = "", row.names = FALSE)

#--3.5--Overall difference detection--------

#--3.5--Comparison of Alpha Diversity Between Categories--------
  
  library(ggforce)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(emmeans)
  library(multcomp)
  library(tidyr)
  library(rcompanion)
  library(multcompView)
  library(stringr)
  library(ggnewscale)
  library(FSA)

  #--3.5a--Dunn Test
    dunn_Subtype <- dunnTest(Shannon ~ Subtype,
                                 data = index,
                                 method = "bh")
      
    dunn_Subtype_res <- dunn_Subtype$res
    
    dunn_Subtype_res$Comparison <- gsub(".2-micron", "02um",
                                        dunn_Subtype_res$Comparison)
    dunn_Subtype_res$Comparison <- gsub("3-micron", "3um",
                                        dunn_Subtype_res$Comparison)
    dunn_Subtype_res$Comparison <- gsub(" - ", "-", dunn_Subtype_res$Comparison)
    dunn_Subtype_res$Comparison <- gsub(" ", ".", dunn_Subtype_res$Comparison)
    
    cld_Subtype <- cldList(comparison = dunn_Subtype_res$Comparison,
                               p.value    = dunn_Subtype_res$P.adj,
                               threshold  = 0.05)[1:2]
    
    cld_Subtype$Subtype <- str_sub(
      gsub("//.", " ", cld_Subtype$Group), end = -4)
    cld_Subtype$Type <- str_sub(cld_Subtype$Group, start = -3)
    
  #--3.5b--ANOVA
    model <- aov(Shannon ~ Subtype, data = index)
    tukey_means <- emmeans(model, "Subtype")
    cld(tukey_means, Letters = letters, adjust = "tukey")

#--3.6--Boxplot of Alpha Diversity by SubType--------
    
  plot_AlphaDiv_Subtype <- 
      phyloseq::plot_richness(ps_raw,
                              x = "Subtype",
                              measures = c("Shannon"),
                              color = "Subtype") +
    annotate("text", x = 1, y = 5.6, label = "a", # DunnTest result
             color = "black", size = 8) +
    annotate("text", x = 1, y = 5.4,
             label = paste0("n = ",
                            nrow(subset_samples(
                              ps_raw,
                              Subtype == "Coral POC")@sam_data)),
             size = 6) +
    annotate("text", x = 2, y = 6.0, label = "bc", # DunnTest result
             color = "black", size = 8) +
    annotate("text", x = 2, y = 5.8,
             label = paste0("n = ",
                            nrow(subset_samples(
                              ps_raw,
                              Subtype == "Coral POR")@sam_data)),
             size = 6) +
    annotate("text", x = 3, y = 4.4, label = "ab", # DunnTest result
             color = "black", size = 8) +
    annotate("text", x = 3, y = 4.2,
             label = paste0("n = ",
                            nrow(subset_samples(
                              ps_raw,
                              Subtype == "Seawater 0.2-micron")@sam_data)),
             size = 6) +

             label = paste0("n = ",
                            nrow(subset_samples(
                              ps_raw,
                              Subtype == "Seawater 3-micron")@sam_data)),
             size = 6) +

                       labels = c("Coral - Pocillopora", "Coral - Porites",

                                  "Sediment")) +

    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 7), expand = c(0, 0),
                       breaks = seq(from = 0, to = 7, by = 1),
                       labels = seq(from = 0, to = 7, by = 1)) +
    scale_x_discrete(
      labels = c("Coral - Pocillopora", "Coral - Porites",
                                  "Seawater - 0.2  µm", "Seawater - 3  µm",
                                  "Sediment")) +
    ylab("Shannon Index") +
    guides(fill = "none") +
    theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
                     panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
                     # legend.position = 'top',
                     panel.background = element_blank(),
                     axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
                     strip.background = element_blank(), 
                     legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = 'bold'),
                     legend.position=c(0.5, 1),
                     legend.direction="horizontal",
                     axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, face="bold.italic",
                                                 angle = 0, 
                                                hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5),
                     axis.text.y = element_text(size = 24, face="bold"),
                     strip.text.x = element_blank(), 
                     axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face="bold"),
                     axis.title.y = element_text(size = 24, face="bold"))
        
  plot_AlphaDiv_Subtype$layers <- plot_AlphaDiv_Subtype$layers[-1]
  plot_AlphaDiv_Subtype
  
  pdf(file =
```

# 4. Community Diversity Analysis - Beta Diversity
*Note*: Rarefaction is used to simulate an even number of reads per sample. The rarefaction depth chosen is usually either 90% or 100% of the minimum sample depth. In this case, the 100% value of 100869 reads/sample is used.

```{r rare-data}
#--4.1--Rarefaction of the data--------

  min_samplecount = min(phyloseq::sample_sums(ps_bact))
  median_samplecount = median(phyloseq::sample_sums(ps_bact))
  
  if (min_samplecount == 0) {
      print("Some samples contain zero sequences")
      print("Median sample count used as rarefaction depth")
      ps_bact_rarefied_median <- phyloseq::rarefy_even_depth(ps_bact,
                                            rngseed = 1,
                                            sample.size = median_samplecount,
                                            replace = FALSE)
      #Save rarefied data as phyloseq object
      save(ps_pruned_rarefied_median, 
           file = paste0(dir_output_dat, "/",  
                         outputPrefix, 
                         "ps_pruned_rarefied_median.RData", sep = ""))
    } else{
      ps_bact_rarefied <- phyloseq::rarefy_even_depth(ps_bact, 
                                             rngseed = 1,
                                             sample.size = min_samplecount,
                                             replace = FALSE)
      #Save rarefied data as phyloseq object
      save(ps_bact_rarefied, 
           file = paste0(dir_output_dat, "/",
                         outputPrefix, 
                         "ps_bact_rarefied.RData", sep = ""))
    }
```

```{r}
# 排序方法选择#----
#---------如果选用DCA排序
if (method == "DCA") {
  # method = "DCA"
  ordi = phyloseq::ordinate(ps_raw_rarefied_rela, method=method, distance=dist)
  #提取样本坐标
  points = ordi$rproj[,1:2]
  colnames(points) = c("x", "y") #命名行名
  #提取特征值
  eig = ordi$evals^2
}

#---------CCA排序#----
if (method == "CCA") {
  # method = "CCA"
  ordi = phyloseq::ordinate(ps_raw_rarefied_rela, method=method, distance=dist)
  #样本坐标,这里可选u或者v矩阵
  points = ordi$CA$v[,1:2]
  colnames(points) = c("x", "y") #命名行名
  #提取特征值
  eig = ordi$CA$eig^2
}

#---------RDA排序#----
if (method == "RDA") {
  # method ="RDA"
  ordi = phyloseq::ordinate(ps_raw_rarefied_rela, method=method, distance=dist)
  #样本坐标,这里可选u或者v矩阵
  points = ordi$CA$v[,1:2]
  colnames(points) = c("x", "y") #命名行名
  #提取特征值
  eig = ordi$CA$eig
}

#---------MDS排序#----
if (method == "MDS") {
  # method = "MDS"
  # ordi = ordinate(ps_raw_rela, method=ord_meths[i], distance=dist)
  ordi = phyloseq::ordinate(ps_raw_rarefied_rela, method=method, distance=dist)
  #样本坐标
  points = ordi$vectors[,1:2]
  colnames(points) = c("x", "y") #命名行名
  #提取解释度
  eig = ordi$values[,1]
}

#---------PCoA排序#----
if (method == "PCoA") {
  # method = "PCoA"
  unif = phyloseq::distance(ps_raw_rarefied_rela , method=dist, type="samples")
  #这里请记住pcoa函数
  pcoa = stats::cmdscale(unif, k=2, eig=T) # k is dimension, 3 is recommended; eig is eigenvalues
  points = as.data.frame(pcoa$points) # 获得坐标点get coordinate string, format to dataframme
  colnames(points) = c("x", "y") #命名行名
  eig = pcoa$eig
}

#----PCA分析#----
# otu_table = as.data.frame(t(ggClusterNet::vegan_otu(ps_raw_rela )))
# head(otu_table)
# method = "PCA"
if (method == "PCA") {
  otu.pca = stats::prcomp(t(otu_table), scale.default = TRUE)
  #提取坐标
  points = otu.pca$x[,1:2]
  colnames(points) = c("x", "y") #命名行名
  # #提取荷载坐标
  # otu.pca$rotation
  # 提取解释度,这里提供的并不是特征值而是标准差，需要求其平方才是特征值
  eig=otu.pca$sdev
  eig=eig*eig
}

#---------------LDA排序#----
if (method == "LDA") {
  #拟合模型
  # library(MASS)
  data = t(otu_table)
  # head(data)
  data = as.data.frame(data)
  # data$ID = row.names(data)
  data = scale(data, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)
  dim(data)
  data1 = data[,1:10]
  map = as.data.frame(sample_data(ps_raw_rarefied_rela))
  model = MASS::lda(data, map$Group)

  # 提取坐标
  ord_in = model
  axes = c(1:2)
  points = data.frame(predict(ord_in)$x[, axes])
  colnames(points) = c("x", "y") #命名行名
  # 提取解释度
  eig= ord_in$svd^2
}




#---------------t-sne排序#----

  # head(data)

  dim(data)

}
```

```{r}
library(ggalluvial)

group  = "Subtype"

  # psdata = ps %>%

    psdata = psdata %>%
      phyloseq::transform_sample_counts(function(x) {x/sum(x)} )
  }
  
  otu = phyloseq::otu_table(psdata)
  tax = phyloseq::tax_table(psdata)
  
  for (i in 1:dim(tax)[1]) {
    if (row.names(tax)[i] %in% names(sort(rowSums(otu), 
                                          decreasing = TRUE)[1:Top])) {
      
      tax[i,j] = tax[i,j]
    } else {
      tax[i,j] = "others"
    }
  }
  
  phyloseq::tax_table(psdata) = tax
  
  Taxonomies <- psdata %>% # Transform to rel. abundance
    phyloseq::psmelt()

  Taxonomies$Abundance = Taxonomies$Abundance * 100
  # Taxonomies$Abundance = Taxonomies$Abundance /rep
  colnames(Taxonomies) <- gsub(j,"aa",colnames(Taxonomies))
  data = c()
  i = 2
  for (i in 1:length(unique(phyloseq::sample_data(ps_raw)$Subtype))) {
    a <- as.data.frame(table(phyloseq::sample_data(ps_raw)$Subtype))[i,1]

    b =  as.data.frame(table(phyloseq::sample_data(ps_raw)$Subtype))[i,2]

    c <- Taxonomies %>% 
      dplyr::filter(Subtype == a)
    c$Abundance <- c$Abundance/b
    data = data.frame(Sample = c$Sample, Abundance = c$Abundance, Taxon = c$aa, Subtype = c$Subtype)

    if (i == 1) {
      table = data
    }
    if (i != 1) {
      table = rbind(table,data)
    }

  }

  Taxonomies = table

  #按照分组求均值

  head(cc)

  ##使用这个属的因子对下面数据进行排序

  # Taxonomies_x$label_y =

    # p5 = p5 + scale_x_discrete(limits = axis_order)
```

## E - Core Microbiome Venn Upsets

```{r}
Venpath = paste(otupath,"/SharedCore_Ven_Upset", sep = "")
dir.create(Venpath)
  
# Step 1 - Install Packages
    #install.packages("eulerr") # If not installed
    library(eulerr)
    library(microbiome)
    #devtools::install_github('microsud/microbiomeutilities')
    library(microbiomeutilities)
    
# Step 2 - Simple way to count number of samples in each group
    table(meta(ps_pruned)$SpeciesType, useNA = "always")
    
    # convert to relative abundances
    pseq.rel <- ps_pruned_rarefied_rela
    # pseq.rel <- microbiome::transform(ps_pruned_rarefied_rela, "compositional")
    
    # Make a list of categories
      #categories <- unique(as.character(meta(pseq.rel)$SpeciesType))
      #print(categories)
      list_regions <- list("Acanthurus triostegus GUT" = sort(unique(as.character(meta(subset_samples(pseq.rel, SpeciesType %in% c("Acanthurus triostegus GUT")))$Region))),
                            "Zanclus cornutus GUT" = sort(unique(as.character(meta(subset_samples(pseq.rel, SpeciesType %in% c("Zanclus cornutus GUT")))$Region))),
                            "Acanthurus triostegus MUC" = sort(unique(as.character(meta(subset_samples(pseq.rel, SpeciesType %in% c("Acanthurus triostegus MUC")))$Region))),
                            "Zanclus cornutus MUC" = sort(unique(as.character(meta(subset_samples(pseq.rel, SpeciesType %in% c("Zanclus cornutus MUC")))$Region))))


    
    # format names
    pseq.rel.f <- format_to_besthit(pseq.rel)
    # check names
    #taxa_names(pseq.Acan.GT.rel.f)[1:5]

    # Write a for loop to go through each of the disease_states one by one and combine identified core taxa into a list.
    
    list_core <- list("Acanthurus triostegus GUT" = list(),
                      "Zanclus cornutus GUT" = list(),
                      "Acanthurus triostegus MUC" = list(),
                      "Zanclus cornutus MUC" = list()) # an empty object to store information
    
    for (j in 1:length(list_regions)) {
      for (n in 1:length(list_regions[[j]])) {
        print(paste0("Identifying Core Taxa for ", names(list_regions[j]), " in Region ", list_regions[[j]][n]))
        ps.sub <- subset_samples(pseq.rel.f, SpeciesType == names(list_regions[j]) & Region == list_regions[[j]][n]) # Subset phyloseq for the chosen microbiome and region
        core_m <- core_members(ps.sub, # ps.sub is phyloseq selected with only samples from microbiome and region of choice 
                             detection = 0.001, # 0.001 in at least 90% samples 
                             prevalence = 0.75)
        print(paste0("No. of core taxa for ",  names(list_regions[j]), " in Region ", list_regions[[j]][n], " : ", length(core_m))) # print core taxa identified in each DiseaseState.
        list_core[[j]][[n]] <- core_m # add to a list core taxa for each group.
        names(list_core[[j]])[n] <- list_regions[[j]][n]
        #print(list_core)
      }
    }
    
    for (j in 1:length(list_regions)) {
      ps.sub <- phyloseq::subset_samples(pseq.rel.f, SpeciesType == names(list_regions[j])) # Subset phyloseq for the chosen microbiome and region
      core_m <- core_members(ps.sub, # ps.sub is phyloseq selected with only samples from microbiome and region of choice 
                             detection = 0.001, # 0.001 in at least 90% samples 
                             prevalence = 0.75)
      list_core[j][[1]][[length(list_core[j][[1]])+1]] <- core_m
      names(list_core[j][[1]])[length(list_core[j][[1]])] <- "All"
    }
    
    library(UpSetR)
    library(ComplexUpset)

    #UpSetR::upset(fromList(list_core[1][[1]]), order.by = "freq")
    
    Acan_GT_CoreDF <- fromList(list_core[1][[1]])
    Acan_GT_CoreDF_sub <- fromList(list_core[1][[1]][c("EP", "FP", "MX", "OG", "PO")])
    
    list_coreplot <- c()
    
    for (j in 1:length(list_core)) {
      
      CoreSetData <- UpSetR::fromList(list_core[j][[1]])
      
      plot_CoreSet <- ComplexUpset::upset(
        data = CoreSetData,
        #intersect = colnames(Acan_GT_CoreDF),
        intersect = c("EP", "FP", "MX", "OG", "PO"),
        width_ratio=0.2,
        matrix=(intersection_matrix(geom=geom_point(shape='circle filled', size=3)) +
                  scale_color_manual(values=c('EP'='goldenrod2', 'FP'='turquoise4', 'PO'='salmon3', 'MX'='lightgoldenrod','OG'='lightpink'),
                                     guide=guide_legend(override.aes=list(shape='circle')))),
        #group_by='sets',
        #sort_sets = "descending",
        #sort_intersections = "descending",
        #sort_intersections_by = c("cardinality"),
        queries=list(
          #   upset_query(group='EP', color='goldenrod2'),
          #   upset_query(group='MX', color='lightgoldenrod'),
          #   upset_query(group='FP', color='turquoise4'),
          #   upset_query(group='OG', color='lightpink'),
          #   upset_query(group='PO', color='salmon3'),
          #   # upset_query(group='Other', color='grey'),
          #   # upset_query(group='All', color='black'),
          upset_query(set='EP', fill='goldenrod2'),
          upset_query(set='MX', fill='lightgoldenrod'),
          upset_query(set='FP', fill='turquoise4'),
          upset_query(set='OG', fill='lightpink'),
          upset_query(set='PO', fill='salmon3'))) +
        ggtitle(paste0(names(list_core[j])))
      
      list_coreplot[[j]] <- plot_CoreSet
    }

    library(cowplot)
    
    plot_CoreSetOverlaps <- plot_grid(list_coreplot[[1]],
                                      list_coreplot[[2]],
                                      list_coreplot[[3]],
                                      list_coreplot[[4]],
                                      align = 'vh', ncol = 2,
                                      labels = c("A", "B", "C", "D"))
    plot_CoreSetOverlaps
    
    pdf(file = paste0(Venpath, "/AllSamples_CoreMicrobiomeVenUpset.pdf"), h = 10, w = 20)
    plot_CoreSetOverlaps
    dev.off()
    
    png(file = paste0(Venpath, "/AllSamples_CoreMicrobiomeVenUpset.png"), h = 10, w = 20, units = "in", res = 300)
    plot_CoreSetOverlaps
    dev.off()
```

## G - Sankey Diagram
```{r}
# BiocManager::install("networkD3")
# BiocManager::install("webshot")

library(ggClusterNet)
library(phyloseq)
snapath =  paste(otupath, "/Sankey_Network", sep = "")
dir.create(snapath)

load("./Data/2-Analysis-ps_pruned_rarefied.RData")
ps <- ps_pruned_rarefied
# ps = readRDS("./data/dataNEW/ps_16s.rds")

rank=6#参数目前不可修改
Top=50
snapath=snapath

map = sample_data(ps) %>% as.tibble()
otu =  ps %>% vegan_otu() %>% 
  as.data.frame()
  otu$SampleID = row.names(otu)
  
  tax = ps %>% 
    scale_micro() %>%
    vegan_tax() %>% 
    as.data.frame()
  
  tax$taxid = row.names(tax)
  
  head(tax)
  

  data = map %>% as.tibble() %>%
    inner_join(otu, by = "SampleID") %>% 
    gather(taxa, count, starts_with("tpac_16S_v2_")) %>%
    inner_join(tax, by = c("taxa" = "taxid") )
  data
  
  
  tax = ps %>% 
    ggClusterNet::tax_glom_wt(ranks = rank) %>%
    ggClusterNet::filter_OTU_ps(Top) %>%
    subset_taxa(!genus  %in% c("Unassigned","Unknown")) %>%
    ggClusterNet::vegan_tax() %>%
    as.data.frame()
  
  head(tax)
  dim(tax)
  
  id2 = c("k", "p", "c", "o", "f", "g")
  dat = NULL
  
  for (i in 1:5) {
    dat <- tax[,c(i,i+1)] %>% distinct(.keep_all = TRUE) 
    colnames(dat) = c("source","target")
    dat$source = paste(id2[i],dat$source,sep = "_")
    dat$target = paste(id2[i+1],dat$target,sep = "_")
    if (i == 1) {
      dat2 = dat
    }  
    
    dat2 = rbind(dat2, dat)
    
  }
  
  dim(dat2)
  # dat2 = dat2 %>% distinct(.keep_all = TRUE) 
  
  head(dat2)
  
  otu = ps %>% 
    ggClusterNet::tax_glom_wt(ranks = 6) %>%
    ggClusterNet::scale_micro() %>%
    ggClusterNet::filter_OTU_ps(Top) %>%
    subset_taxa(!genus  %in% c("Unassigned","Unknown")) %>%
    ggClusterNet::vegan_otu() %>%
    t() %>%
    as.data.frame()
  
  head(otu)
  otutax = cbind(otu,tax)
  
  id = rank.names(ps)[1:6]
  dat = NULL
  dat3 = NULL
  head(data)
  
  for (j in 1) {
    dat = data %>% group_by(SpeciesType,!!sym(rank_names(ps)[j])) %>%
      summarise_if(is.numeric,sum,na.rm = TRUE)
    colnames(dat) = c("source","target","value")
    dat$target = paste(id2[j],dat$target,sep = "_")
    
    if (j == 1) {
      dat3 = dat
    }  
    dat3 = rbind(dat3,dat)
  }
  
  
  dat3 %>% tail()
  tem = data.frame(target = dat3$target,value = dat3$value)
  dat3$value = NULL
  dat2 <- rbind(dat3, dat2)
  
  
  head(otutax)
  for (i in 1:6) {
    dat <- otutax %>%
      dplyr::group_by(!!sym(id[i])) %>%
      summarise_if(is.numeric,sum,na.rm = TRUE)
    
    dat = data.frame(Genus = dat[,1],value =rowSums(dat[,-1]) )
    colnames(dat) = c("target","value")
    dat$target = paste(id2[i],dat$target,sep = "_")
    if (i == 1) {
      dat3 = dat
    }  
    
    dat3 = rbind(dat3,dat)
  }
  
  dat4 <- dat2 %>% left_join(dat3)
  sankey = dat4
  
  head( sankey )
  
  
  nodes <- data.frame(name = unique(c(as.character(sankey$source),as.character(sankey$target))),stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  nodes$ID <- 0:(nrow(nodes)-1)
  sankey <- merge(sankey,nodes,by.x = "source",by.y = "name")
  sankey <- merge(sankey,nodes,by.x = "target",by.y = "name")
  colnames(sankey) <- c("X","Y","value","source","target")
  sankey <- subset(sankey,select = c("source","target","value"))
  nodes <- subset(nodes,select = c("name"))
  
  ColourScal='d3.scaleOrdinal() .range(["#E41A1C", "#377EB8", "#4DAF4A", "#984EA3", "#FF7F00", "#FFFF33", "#A65628", "#F781BF", "#999999"])'
  
  sankey$energy_type <- sub(' .*', '', nodes[sankey$source + 1, 'name'])
  library(networkD3)
  p <- sankeyNetwork(Links = sankey, Nodes = nodes,
                     Source = "source",Target = "target",Value = "value",
                     NodeID = "name",
                     sinksRight=FALSE,
                     LinkGroup = 'energy_type',
                     colourScale= ColourScal, 
                     # nodeWidth=40,
                     # fontSize=13
                     # nodePadding=20
  )

# return(list(p,sankey))

dat = sankey

FileName <-paste(snapath, "/Sankey_Group.csv", sep = "")
write.csv(dat,FileName,sep = "")

saveNetwork(p,paste(snapath, "/Sankey_Group.html", sep = ""))
library(webshot)
```

```{r}
# LEfSe Analysis

library(microeco)
library(file2meco)

# subset phyloseq to include only genotype samples (of POC)
ps_bact_rarefied_genoPOR <- phyloseq::subset_samples(ps_bact_rarefied,
                           Host %in% c("POR")
                           & Transplant %in% c("Genotype"))

# ps_raw_rarefied_genoPOC <- phyloseq::subset_samples(ps_raw_rarefied,

#                              Site %in% c("Tiahura") &

# 
# ps_raw_rarefied_genoPOC_noorganelles <- 
#   ps_raw_rarefied_genoPOC %>%
#   subset_taxa(
#     Order != "Chloroplast" &
#     Family != "Mitochondria"
#   )

mt <- file2meco::phyloseq2meco(ps_bact_rarefied_genoPOR)

# Differential Abundance Analysis between the two sites (Genotype samples only)
  SitePair <- unique(sample_data(ps_bact_rarefied_genoPOR)$Site)
  SitePair_short <- c("Tia", "Opu")
  
  data_microtab_Site <- list()

  data_diffabun_Site <- list()
  
  plot_LDA_Site <- list()
  
  plot_diffabun_Site <- list()
  
  library(xlsx)
  for (j in 1:length(SitePair)) {
    # Create microtable containing subset of data for the desired species x tissue Pair
    data_microtab_Site[[j]] <- file2meco::phyloseq2meco(
      phyloseq::subset_samples(ps_bact_rarefied_genoPOR,
                               Site %in% c(paste(SitePair[j]))))
      
    # Perform the differential abundance analysis using microeco package
    data_diffabun_Site[[j]] <- microeco::trans_diff$new(
      dataset = data_microtab_Site[[j]],
      taxa_level = "all", method = "lefse", p_adjust_method = "fdr",
      group = "Site", alpha = 0.05, lefse_subgroup = NULL)
    
    # Write results (relative and differential abundances) to respective tables
    write.xlsx(data_diffabun_Site[[j]]$res_abund,
               file = paste(dir_output_tab, "/", 
                            outputPrefix, "Table-SX_", SitePair_short[j],
                            "_LEfSe-Results_Genotype-Site.xlsx", sep=""),
               sheetName="Res_RelAbund", append=TRUE, row.names = FALSE)
    
    write.xlsx(data_diffabun_Site[[j]]$res_diff,
               file = paste(dir_output_tab, "/", 
                            outputPrefix, "Table-SX_", SitePair_short[j],
                            "_LEfSe-Results_Genotype-Site.xlsx", sep=""),
               sheetName="Res_DiffAbund", append=TRUE, row.names = FALSE)
  
    # LDA BarPlot of the top 20 differentially abundant taxa (highest LDA scores) across regions

    plot_LDA_Site[[j]] <- 
      data_diffabun_Site[[j]]$plot_diff_bar(width = 0.8,
                                           use_number = 1:40,
                                           group_order = c("Site",
                                                           color_values = c("grey", "darkorchid4")) +
      ggtitle(label = paste(SitePair[j])))

    ggsave(plot_LDA_Site[[j]],
           filename = paste(dir_output_fig, "/", 
                            outputPrefix, "Figure-SX_", SitePair_short[j],
                            "_LEfSe-LDAScores_Genotype-Site.pdf", sep=""),
           device = "pdf",
           height = 15, width = 22, units = "in")

    ggsave(plot_LDA_Site[[j]],
           filename = paste(dir_output_fig, "/", 
                            outputPrefix, "Figure-SX_", SitePair_short[j],
                            "_LEfSe-LDAScores_Genotype-Site.png", sep=""),
           device = "png",
           height = 15, width = 22, units = "in", dpi = 300)
    
    # Relative Abundance Barplot of the top 20 differentially abundant taxa

    plot_diffabun_Site[[j]] <- 
      data_diffabun_Site[[j]]$plot_diff_abund(use_number = 1:20, 
                                             plot_type = "barerrorbar",
                                             errorbar_addpoint = FALSE,
                                             coord_flip = TRUE,
                                             errorbar_color_black = TRUE,
                                             plot_SE = TRUE,
                                             group_order = c("Tiahura",
                                                             "Opunohu"),
                                                                           color_values = c("grey", "darkorchid4")) +
      ggtitle(label = paste(SppTissPair[j])) +
      theme(plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
            axis.text.x = element_text(size = 30),
            axis.text.y = element_text(size = 30),
            text = element_text(size = 30),
            #axis.text=element_text(size=50),
            axis.title=element_text(size=12, face="bold"))

    ggsave(plot_diffabun_Site[[j]],
           filename = paste(dir_output_fig, "/", 
                            outputPrefix, "Figure-SX_", SitePair_short[j],
                            "_LEfSe-DiffAbund_Genotype-Site.pdf", sep=""),
           device = "pdf",
           height = 15, width = 22, units = "in")

    ggsave(plot_diffabun_Site[[j]],
           filename = paste(dir_output_fig, "/", 
                            outputPrefix, "Figure-SX_", SitePair_short[j],
                            "_LEfSe-DiffAbund_Genotype-Site.png", sep=""),
           device = "png",
           height = 15, width = 22, units = "in", dpi = 300)
  }
```

```{r}
# Comparison between sample Types (Coral vs Seawater vs Sediment)
data_microtab_Type <- file2meco::phyloseq2meco(
  phyloseq::subset_samples(ps_bact,
                           #Host %in% c("POC") &
                           Type %in% c("Coral", "Sediment", "Seawater")
                           ))
data_diffabun_Type <- microeco::trans_diff$new(
  dataset = data_microtab_Type,
  taxa_level = "all", method = "lefse", p_adjust_method = "BH",
  group = "Type", alpha = 0.05, lefse_subgroup = NULL)

plot_LDA_Type <- data_diffabun_Type$plot_diff_bar(threshold = 3.5, 
                                                  width = 0.8,
                                                  use_number = 1:10)
plot_Clade_Type <- data_diffabun_Type$plot_diff_cladogram(use_taxa_num = 200,
                                                          use_feature_num = 20,
                                                          clade_label_level = 5)

# Comparison between Sites (Genotype Samples)
data_microtab_Site <- file2meco::phyloseq2meco(

  dataset = data_microtab_Site,

FileName1 <- paste(betapath,"/LefSE_LDA_POC_GenotypexSite.pdf", sep = "")

ps_test <- subset_samples(ps,
                          !Type %in% c("Control"))
min_samplecount = min(phyloseq::sample_sums(ps_test))
median_samplecount = median(phyloseq::sample_sums(ps_test))

if (min_samplecount == 0) {
    print("Some samples contain zero sequences")
    print("Median sample count used as rarefaction depth")
    ps_pruned_rarefied_median <- phyloseq::rarefy_even_depth(ps_pruned,
                                          rngseed = 1,
                                          sample.size = median_samplecount,
                                          replace = FALSE)
    #Save rarefied data as phyloseq object
    save(ps_pruned_rarefied_median, file = paste0("./Data/",  outputPrefix, "ps_pruned_rarefied_median.RData", sep = ""))
  } else{
    ps_pruned_rarefied <- phyloseq::rarefy_even_depth(ps_pruned, 
                                           rngseed = 1,
                                           sample.size = min_samplecount,
                                           replace = FALSE)
    #Save rarefied data as phyloseq object
    save(ps_pruned_rarefied, file = paste0("./Data/",  outputPrefix, "ps_pruned_rarefied.RData", sep = ""))
  }

sample_data(ps)['sample_id'] <- row.names(sample_data(ps)) 
# generate ordination and plot
ps_pruned_rarefied_rela <- microbiome::transform(ps_pruned_rarefied, transform = "compositional")
ordcap <- ordinate(ps, "NMDS", "bray", ~Type)
plot_ordination(ps, ordcap, "samples", label="sample_id") + theme_minimal()
```
